paragraphs: R' Tanhuma: Hullin 55b. He and R' Abba bar Kahana in R' Elazar's name: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Keitzad Mevarekhin. In R' Huna's name: Jerusalem Yevamot, chapters 4 and 10, halakhah 7. R' Hagga of the South was in his time. In R' Huna's name: Hallah 1:4. In R' Hiyya bar Menahama's name. In R' Yehoshua ben Korhah's name: Vayikra Rabbah, ע״א [provisionally at 1; edition/locator uncollated]. In R' Nahman son of R' Shmuel bar Nahman's name. In Resh Lakish's name: Shevuot 1:8.
